ResearchTabDef.label: animals at work
ResearchTabDef.generalDescription: Research related to animal power: harnessing, hitching, and putting farm animals to work.

ResearchProjectDef.label: harnessing
ResearchProjectDef.description: Craft draft harnesses fitted to farm animals. A harness spreads the strain across the beast's shoulders and opens the way to animal labor: plows, carts and hitched implements.

ResearchProjectDef.label: carting
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build wooden draft carts. A beast hitched to a cart loads several stacks at once and delivers them in a single trip around the colony, and carries an extra hundred kilograms in caravans.
